target_customer: Product security, privacy and GRC teams at enterprises that review many products
problem: Security and privacy reviews are manual and slow, so only a fraction of products get reviewed.
product_category: AI security and privacy review and threat modeling

founders.name: Emily Choi-Greene
education: Dartmouth College, computer science with high honors
founders.background_notes: YC page: five years at Amazon leading Alexa AI Security, then owned data security and privacy at Moveworks.

founders.name: Joe Choi-Greene
education: Carnegie Mellon University, computer science degree
founders.background_notes: YC page: senior engineer at Amazon, led satellite telemetry for Project Kuiper and exabyte datalakes at Alexa.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM agents that ingest design docs, tickets and repos and produce cited threat models need many integrations and accuracy controls but rely on existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration into enterprise review workflows and credibility from Amazon scale reviews; competing automated threat modeling vendors exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established threat modeling vendors existed; I found no dated evidence of copying and no acquisition of Clearly AI as of 2026.

market_need_then: Founders say they ran hundreds of reviews at Amazon and Moveworks; reviews were a manual bottleneck as AI features multiplied.

branding.domain_note: Uses clearly-ai.com, with a hyphen, not an exact short .com.

identity.visual_style: Animated workflow diagrams with color-coded severity and product screenshots

branding.community_and_virality: RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox top 10 finalist per search results, which is recognition of the company rather than the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name and hyphenated domain; only pending trademark filings and no sourced brand press.

outcome_analysis: Clearly AI is active, raised an $8.4M seed in February 2026 led by Basis Set and was an RSAC 2026 Innovation Sandbox finalist. Founders with Amazon security review experience and named enterprise customers such as Ericsson and Rivian support early traction, though company claims are unaudited.
notes: Seed amount and date from Basis Set (lead investor) and a GeekWire headline on the YC page; GeekWire itself returned 403. Investor list beyond Basis Set comes from search snippet of the same announcement. A newsletter mentions $5M in SAFE notes and Seedtable lists a pre-seed in Oct 2024; both unverified and not recorded. Dated competitor search returned only 2025 and 2026 vendor material, so the list is empty.
